text.p: These are the main headlines on Hungary's Kossuth Radio midday news. Reuters cannot vouch for their accuracy:
- A car of the security guards of Croatian President Franjo Tudjman, who visited Hungary earlier this week, was stolen in Budapest last Friday.
- Postabank, hit by panic-triggered deposit withdrawals recently, may get further help from the goverment, if the state grants it credit guarantee.
- Cuba said the protest of Hungarian opposition party Fidesz against Cuba's plans to organise a World Youth Festival, was tough provocation.
- Gabor Slosar and Zsuzsanna Hollo, ex-managers of the Hungarian Enterprise Development Fund who were alleged with the misappropriation of 700 million forints, have been cleared by the court.
